lines.en: It’s Saturday night and I’m ready to party.
Just kidding. I hate myself and I’m ready to die.
But it is Saturday night, and that means something to most people. So I will stand here in the middle of the sidewalk and wait for someone to drag me into whatever they’re doing right now.
: I’m bored.
Upon voicing my boredom, my phone immediately begins to ring, proving once more that there probably is a god out there watching over me and toying with my every emotion.
Now please excuse me as I continue to ignore it in favor of whoever’s on the other end of the phone.
: Hello?
: Yo! Happy Saturday. Are you ready to party?
: You know it, Rika.
: Okay, never mind then. I needed help with something.
: Oh.
: Well...I’m ready for that too, I guess. What do you need help with?

: I’m officially moving into my new place today and need some extra hands. Imani’s coming too. So I’ll buy you guys pizza or beer since the Internet said that’s how I’m supposed to pay friends who help me.
: I could have sworn you already had a place of your own. Have you really been with Rin this entire time?
: I’ve been moving around. Long story. But this place should be cool! I think. I hope. Maybe. Anyway! Are you in or out? Speak now or I will forever hold this pizza.
: I’m in. Just send me the address.
: Oh, shit. I forgot to get the address. Let me call you back!
: Just text it to me, Rika.
: No can do, bud! The government is watching. They read every single one of our texts.
: Anyway, BRB. I have to text the landlord my kojin bangō so they know I’m legit and can send me the address. But then I’ll call you back! Promise!
: You still there?
: Yeah.
: Well, stop! Do some stretches or something! And start heading over! Bye!
Rika hangs up the phone and I am once again very worried about how she is ever supposed to survive on her own.
At least when she was rooming with Rin, she had her to rein her in and...probably teach her how to do laundry and whatnot. But now, I fear that person is going to wind up being me.
And that’s very worrying since I only kind of know how to do laundry. Or anything really.
Oh well. I’ll just hope that she finds another girlfriend soon. Or that all of my school-friends adopt polyamory so she can just join the Wakana/Osako relationship.
And hey, if those two are still struggling, maybe Rika can be the missing link that binds their chain back together?
Or maybe that would make life way too convenient for everyone involved and only serve to tear down the barrier between all of them and my penis. So hey, a man can dream.
And a man can also help move stuff around in exchange for pizza and beer, so excuse me as I graduate to a level past “confused adolescent boy in a grown man’s body” for an hour or two.
: Hey! Thanks for showing up. I decided to keep Imani outside so the two of you could see how awesome and cool my new apartment is at the same time.
: Hey, Senpai! Were you able to find the place okay?
: Yeah. Really easily, actually.
: Oh yeah?
: Was it because my apartment is literally right there?!?!?!
: You know, I thought this place looked familiar.
: What’s the problem, Imani? Now we can stay up all night and talk about when we were young. You can even teach me how to do laundry!
: Don’t remind me that I’m not young anymore! I am very sensitive when it comes to that subject!
: Then why are you going around making out with people in their forties?
: That was one time.
: And a totally forgettable one at that! So yeah, now it’ll be easier for you to find me. Which you’ve never attempted to do before. But now you can! If you want. Which you probably don’t.
: I’m already over here a decent amount since Imani’s two doors down and the girl in the room next to yours is another one of my friends.

: You’re friends with the cool biker bartender lady? What’s her name? I forgot. Is she a lesbian? Because my gay-dar didn’t ring at all, but I’m getting conflicting vibes from all the leather and denim.
: You’ve lived here for three minutes and you’re already planning on hooking up with your neighbor?
: You know what they say, Imani. If the shoe fits, go fuck a girl.
: Since when do they say that?...
: Yuki is, to my knowledge, very straight. But you’ve turned women before, so maybe you can work your magic on her as well.
: Do you know her age? Is she older than me?
: Late thirties, I believe.
: Damn, really? Could’ve fooled me. She looks way older than Rika.
: Yeah, but Rika also looks way too young for her age and Yuki had a drug problem for a while. I’m sure that plays some role in her appearance.
: I’m starting to worry that I’m the oldest woman in Kumon-mi...No one is ever going to love me again and Rin is going to have to find a third mom when the garbage men accidentally collect my body.
: Oh well, though. If all else fails, I guess there’s you. I can subject myself to a life of 6/10 makeout sessions if you’re above average when it comes to hand stuff.
: Rika, this better be a fuckin’ damn good pizza.
: Fuck! I forgot the pizza!
: Weren’t you literally holding it when you called me?
: I must have dropped it somewhere! Why does this keep happening to me every time I buy a pizza?!
: This has happened more than once?!?
: Oh! You know what, maybe I left it inside before you guys got here. There’s only one way to find out! Onward, gang!
Rika pushes her way through the door and pridefully marches to the center of a room that looks a lot like Imani’s and Yuki’s.
Just...with one glaring difference.
: Isn’t it just beautiful?! I bet Rie’s shaking in her boots now. Rika’s back on the market and back out in the world!
: Wait, when did Rie get boots? Rie never wore boots. Are they mine? Do they still fit?
: Rika, question. What the fuck is going on in here?
: Huh? What do you mean?
: I think she’s talking about how the place is completely empty. Both Imani and Yuki’s places came furnished.
: I mean, I’m not sure if I’d say completely empty.
: There’s certainly...some stuff in it.
: Yeah, I feel like this might be one of those cases where less would actually be more.
: It’s a work in progress, sure! But I got a hefty discount after the last couple in here was murdered. They wouldn’t let me keep any of their stuff, though. Dumb rule.
: You actually wanted it?
: You really think I’m in the position to turn down a free couch, Imani? Plus, those girls had a damn Macbook. A Macbook! I’ve always wanted to read one of those.
: Does she think a Macbook is an actual-
: Would it really surprise you if she did? Rika, this is an active crime scene. You can’t live here.
: There’s also a rat eating an entire cheese wheel on the ground.
: Oh, yeah. I gave him that. He’s my son now. And soon, he’ll be off to rat college where he’ll live in his little rat dorm and-
: Rats live for like three years max.
: Nooooo! My son!
: I’m never going to get another minute of peace in this apartment complex again, am I?
: Rika, why are we even here?
: You really think I’m the person you should be asking that question to? I only just learned where the ropes are a couple months ago. Give me a break, man.
: No, Rika. He’s obviously talking about how you called us over here for the sole purpose of helping you move. But you have nothing to move.
: Technically, I never said I needed help moving — just that I needed extra hands.
: Which I do for all the high fives I should be getting! Put her there, homie!
: Rika-
: Don’t encourage her! She just wasted hours worth of time that we could have spent having sex with each other!
: Yeah, except for the part where you guys don’t even have sex. Remember how I almost paid the taco guy to bone you? That like literally just happened.
: Taco guy? You mean Taco Man? The one who works in the subway?
: Probably. He sell tacos?
: I’m not sure he knows how to do anything else.
: Yeah well you might be right because he didn’t seem all that excited about boning Imani either. Maybe she’s just cursed.
: Rika, you are right. We haven’t had sex.
: Duuuuuh. If that happened, you guys-
: But Senpai may have eaten me out for over three hours in one sitting. So sex is clearly the next step.
: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!??!?!!
: You look...way too happy about this.
: Are you sure it’s okay to just come out and tell her like that?
: Okay?! Why would it not be okay?! This is the greatest news I’ve ever heard in my life!
: Two of my best friends engaging in a healthy session of consensual cunnilingus for three whole hours?! KYAAAAAH!
: Wait. It was consensual, right? She didn’t just force you down there?
: It was consensual, yes.
: Haaaaaaaaaaaaaah!!!!!!!!!
: Bruh.
: Hey, you can’t blame me for thinking you might have gone a little stir crazy the moment you saw him. A decade-long dry spell could kill a girl. I start feeling faint after like one month.
: But it’s been way longer than a month since you’ve broken up with Rie hasn’t it?
: Yes.
: If you fuck Rika before me...I swear to God, Senpai.
: Well, considering that we now have an entire night to not help Rika move-
: Hell no, we don’t! The hands part might be over after the singular high five I received, but now we’ve gotta celebrate the two of you finally tying the labial knot!
: Can you please never call it that again?
: Fine. Then we’ve gotta celebrate how this nonstop game of “will they, won’t they” has turned into a completed game of “they will!”
: I’m like, super happy for you guys. No joke. You deserve nothing but happiness and multiple orgasms every night for the rest of your life.
: Well...thanks, Rika. I...we really appreciate that.
: But it’s not like we have to celebrate it. Let’s just...head over to a furniture shop and try to find you...a futon or something so you don’t have to crash at my place again.
: This late at night? Nothing’s going to be open.
: Yeah, but I can’t go back to your place either if you’re about to invite me since you’re Imani’s crush and probably my daughter’s too.
: I’m not inviting you to my place. I’m agreeing that we should go out and celebrate. Even...if it feels kind of strange to throw a party over me putting my mouth on Imani’s vagina.
: Low key, Wakana and I already threw a mini-party about that. But that party was pretty much just the two of us getting shit-faced and binging all of Wednesday on Netflix. Her choice, obviously.
: Then it’s definitely my turn! And it will give me the excuse to use some of the money I saved from this apartment on repaying you guys! Everyone wins!
: Except the Yamazaki family. God rest their souls.
: Okay! Resting done! Let’s go get drunk and talk about all the sex you two are gonna have from now on!
: Hah...fiiiiine. But I swear, if you bail before we get the check, I will find you. I know where you live now.
: Have I ever done that before?
: Yes. Several times.
: Wait, really? Also, can I crash at your place again tonight? Because the alternative is Sensei’s place and you saw the way we looked at each other a couple minutes ago. There’s tension there.
: Yeah, I noticed and I hate it! So yes, you can sleep at my place! And you are now banned from making eye contact with Senpai for the rest of the night.
: But his eyes are so pretty! Look! Look at ‘em!
Rika grabs my face and aims it at Imani while pushing the two of us outdoors.
But just as we turn the corner to head over to our regular dive bar, Rika proclaims that she wants something more special tonight.
My suggestion of a love hotel is promptly denied by both of them (which is honestly surprising, but whatever) so I suggest another bar instead.
And seeing as I only know one other bar, you can probably guess where we’re headed...
